privacy.p1: zcrypt is built on a zero-knowledge architecture. This means we are technically unable to access the contents of your encrypted files. This Privacy Policy explains what we can see, what we collect, and how we use it.
privacy.p2: Due to our zero-knowledge encryption design:
privacy.p3: File contents, encrypted client-side with AES-256-GCM before upload.
privacy.p4: Your passphrase, never transmitted to or stored on our servers.
privacy.p5: Encryption keys, derived locally on your device from your passphrase.
privacy.p6: We can't read your files. Not because of a policy, because of mathematics.
privacy.p9: We collect the minimum data necessary to operate the Service.
privacy.p11: Email address (for authentication and service communications)
privacy.p13: Hashed password (bcrypt; we never store plaintext passwords)
privacy.p14: OAuth provider IDs (if you sign in with Google or GitHub)
privacy.p16: File and folder names: encrypted client-side by default, so the server stores only an opaque name it cannot read (some older files may retain a plaintext name in a legacy column we are retiring)
privacy.p17: File sizes (encrypted size, for storage-usage display)
privacy.p22: IP addresses (for rate limiting and abuse prevention)
privacy.p27: When you connect a storage platform (GitHub, GitLab, Hugging Face, Telegram), your platform access token is encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM with a key derived from our master key. Tokens are only decrypted in memory during active upload/download operations.
privacy.p30: To provide and maintain the Service
privacy.p31: To enforce rate limits and prevent abuse
privacy.p32: To send essential account communications (verification, password reset)
privacy.p34: To improve the Service (aggregate, anonymized usage statistics only)
privacy.p37: We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.p39: We do not track you across websites.
privacy.p40: We do not scan your files for any purpose (we cannot. They are encrypted).
privacy.p41: No ads, no tracking, no data sales. Your data isn't our product, the service is.
privacy.p42: We do not share data with law enforcement without valid legal process, and even then, we can only provide account metadata, not file contents.
privacy.p45: We use the following third-party services:
privacy.p46: Neon. PostgreSQL database hosting (stores account metadata, not file contents)
privacy.p50: Your encrypted files are stored on the platforms you connect (GitHub, GitLab, Hugging Face, Telegram). Those platforms' privacy policies apply to the storage of encrypted data on their infrastructure.
privacy.p53: Account data is retained while your account is active.
privacy.p54: Upon account deletion, your metadata is removed within 30 days.
privacy.p55: Encrypted files on managed storage are scheduled for deletion upon account closure.
privacy.p56: Security logs are retained for up to 90 days.
privacy.p57: BYOB data remains on your infrastructure, you control its lifecycle.
privacy.p62: Delete your account and all associated data
privacy.p63: Export your files at any time (they are always downloadable)
privacy.p67: zcrypt is not intended for users under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16.
privacy.p70: We may update this Privacy Policy. Significant changes will be communicated via email or in-app notification at least 30 days before taking effect.
privacy.a77: What we can see, what we collect, and what we'll never touch. Last updated July 2026.
privacy.contactRights: For GDPR, CCPA, or other data protection requests, contact <l1>{email}</l1>.
